target_buyer_1.type: Metal Plating Company / ISO Certified Manufacturer
target_buyer_1.location: Jefferson, OH (Ashtabula County) and El Paso, TX
target_buyer_1.why_top_candidate: Trusted leader in metal finishing industry with facilities in Ashtabula County (Jefferson facility). Serves North America's leading manufacturers and distributors. Automated facilities with experienced platers and continuous improvement professionals. Data-driven, systems approach to plating. Capabilities: plate complex and delicate parts, high-volume orders, small lot orders. Certifications: ISO 9001:2015 and IATF 16949:2016 (DQS Inc.), Ohio Ashtabula facility certified to ISO 9001:2015 (Intertek). Job tracking and quality management platform would support their high standards.

target_buyer_2.why_top_candidate: Veteran-owned business (Army, Retired), member since February 2019. Specializes in plating, polishing, painting, restorations and repair. Services: Restorations, copper, nickel, chrome, painting, polishing, metal repair. Hours: Mon-Fri 8am-4pm (Eastern). Emergency service available. Digital platform would help manage restoration projects and customer communications for this local Ashtabula County business.
